name: io.storiez/agents
title: Storiez
description: Drive real engagement with posts in your brand's voice on LinkedIn, X, Instagram and Facebook.

tools.name: list-personas
tools.description: Returns all brand personas of the account. A persona is a brand voice: tone, audience, writing style and visual identity used for generated posts.

tools.name: get-persona
tools.description: Returns one persona with all brand voice fields (tone, audience, colors, fonts, logos, design examples) and connectionIds, the accounts it may post to.

tools.name: create-persona
tools.description: Creates a brand persona. Only name and type (PERSONAL or COMPANY) are required. Returns the new persona. Files (font, logos, design examples) are uploaded with presign-upload first and passed as asset objects.

type.description: PERSONAL for an individual, COMPANY for a business

targetAudience.description: Who the brand is speaking to

tone.description: Tone of voice, e.g. "professional, warm, witty"

messagingApproach.description: How the brand communicates its message

visualStyleGuidelines.description: Visual identity rules for generated images — layout, colour usage, what images may and may not contain.

designPrinciples.description: The quality gate every generated image must pass — what the visual is trying to achieve for the reader.

colors.description: Brand colours used in generated images

brandFonts.description: Typeface for text in generated images, e.g. "Inter Bold". The font file itself goes in the font field.

font.description: Font file asset. Upload the TTF via presign-upload (kind "persona"), then pass the asset here.

key.description: S3 object key returned by presign-upload

url.description: Public/signed URL of the uploaded file

key.description: S3 object key returned by presign-upload

url.description: Public/signed URL of the uploaded file

url.description: Public/signed URL of the uploaded file

designExamples.description: Reference designs the generated images must match

key.description: S3 object key returned by presign-upload

url.description: Public/signed URL of the uploaded file

items.description: An uploaded asset. presign-upload first, PUT the bytes to the returned URL, then pass the object here.

artworks.description: Artwork samples that define the visual style

key.description: S3 object key returned by presign-upload

url.description: Public/signed URL of the uploaded file

items.description: An uploaded asset. presign-upload first, PUT the bytes to the returned URL, then pass the object here.

tools.description: Changes the given fields of a persona and leaves all other fields as they are. Returns the updated persona.

key.description: S3 object key returned by presign-upload

url.description: Public/signed URL of the uploaded file

tools.name: delete-persona
tools.description: Deletes a persona and everything tied to it: its calendar items, all their posts including published ones, and its connections unless another persona uses them. Publishing through those connections stops. Irreversible. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary of what would be deleted, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

confirmToken.description: Token from the first call of this delete. Omitted: nothing is deleted and a summary plus token is returned.

tools.name: list-connections
tools.description: Returns the connected social accounts (publishing destinations) of the account, such as one LinkedIn page or one Instagram business account. status is CONNECTED, EXPIRED, ERROR or PLACEHOLDER. Can be filtered by personaId.

personaId.description: Only return connections for this persona

tools.name: get-connection
tools.description: Returns one connection: platform, name, status, approval setting (needsApproval) and when its login expires (validTill). Never returns tokens.

tools.name: start-connection
tools.description: Starts connecting a LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram or X account. Returns an authorization URL that must be opened in a web browser to finish; this tool cannot finish the connection itself. The new connection then appears in list-connections.

platform.description: The platform to connect. Use "twitter" for X.

personaId.description: Persona to associate this connection with

tools.name: refresh-connection
tools.description: Renews the login of an EXPIRED or expiring connection. Returns the new status. LinkedIn and X renew; Facebook and Instagram renew only before they expire, otherwise they need start-connection again.

tools.name: delete-connection
tools.description: Removes one publishing destination and its authorization. Publishing to it stops until it is connected again. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

confirmToken.description: Token from the first call of this delete. Omitted: nothing is deleted and a summary plus token is returned.

tools.name: list-content-events
tools.description: Returns calendar items (content events). A calendar item is one planned post topic in one persona's voice for one or more connections at a date. Can be filtered by status, date range and campaign. Paginated with limit and skip.

status.description: Filter by status: DRAFT, EXTRACTING, GENERATING, GENERATED, SCHEDULED, PUBLISHING, PUBLISHED, PUBLISH_FAILED, FAILED

fromDate.description: Only events from this date onward (ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01)

tools.name: get-content-event
tools.description: Returns one calendar item: topic, goal, persona, selected connections, date, format (contentFormat "image" or "carousel", with carouselSlides) and status.

tools.name: create-content-event
tools.description: Creates a calendar item (topic, persona, destinations, date, format). Does not generate posts; generation is a separate step (trigger-generation). Destinations are given as platforms (network names, resolved to the persona's connected accounts) or selectedConnections (connection IDs); with neither, generation later fails with "No connected platforms found". The format is a single image by default; contentFormat "carousel" with carouselSlides makes each post of the item one post of several slides. The returned item shows the format that was saved.

selectedPersonaId.description: The persona ID whose brand voice to use for generated content

date.description: ISO date for when to publish (defaults to now)

title.description: Optional title for this calendar item

textInput.description: The topic or text to generate content from

websiteURL.description: A source URL to extract content from

goals.description: The marketing goal for this content

platforms.description: Platforms to publish to, by name: "linkedin", "x" (or "twitter"), "facebook", "instagram". The tool resolves these to the persona's connected accounts automatically.

selectedConnections.description: Specific connection IDs to publish to (advanced). Takes precedence over platforms. Pass platforms or selectedConnections: with neither, generation fails with "No connected platforms found".

generateImage.description: Whether to generate an image (default: true)

contentFormat.description: What each post of this item is: "image" (one still image, the default) or "carousel" (one post of several slides).

carouselSlides.description: Number of slides of a carousel, 3 to 10 (X shows 4 at most). A carousel without a slide count is saved as a single image.

tools.name: update-content-event
tools.description: Changes the given fields of a calendar item. Changing the date moves its unpublished posts with it. Changing contentFormat or carouselSlides applies to posts generated afterwards; existing posts stay as they are. Returns the updated item.

id.description: The content event ID to update

platforms.description: Platforms to publish to, by name ("linkedin", "x"/"twitter", "facebook", "instagram"). Resolved to the persona's connected accounts. Takes precedence over selectedConnections.

contentFormat.description: "image" (one still image) or "carousel" (one post of several slides). Applies to posts generated afterwards.

carouselSlides.description: Number of slides of a carousel, 3 to 10 (X shows 4 at most). Sent together with contentFormat "carousel".

tools.name: finalize-content-event
tools.description: Processes the ready posts of a calendar item: posts on connections without approval (needsApproval false) are scheduled and publish publicly at their time; posts on connections with approval stay READY_TO_APPROVE.

id.description: The content event ID to finalize

tools.name: delete-content-event
tools.description: Deletes a calendar item and its posts, except posts already PUBLISHED or PUBLISHING, which stay. Returns 409 while generation is running. Irreversible. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

id.description: The content event ID to delete

confirmToken.description: Token from the first call of this delete. Omitted: nothing is deleted and a summary plus token is returned.

tools.name: list-posts
tools.description: Returns posts. A post is one finished piece of content (copy plus a single image or a carousel) for one connection; one calendar item makes one post per connection. Can be filtered by status, platform and calendar item (initiatorId). Paginated with limit and skip.

status.description: Filter by status: GENERATION_IN_PROGRESS, GENERATING, EXTRACTING, COPY_GENERATED, READY_TO_APPROVE, SCHEDULED, REGENERATING, PUBLISHING, PUBLISHED, PUBLISH_FAILED, NOT_PUBLISHED_TOKEN_EXPIRED, GENERATION_FAILED, REJECTED, DRAFT

platform.description: Filter by platform: LINKEDIN, FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, X

tools.name: get-post
tools.description: Returns one post: copy, headline, image URL, format (contentFormat), platform, connection, schedule, status and publish time. A carousel post also returns its slides in order.

tools.name: approve-post
tools.description: Approves a post for publishing on its social network. A post whose scheduled time has passed publishes immediately; otherwise it becomes SCHEDULED and publishes at that time. Costs no credits.

tools.name: regenerate-post-text
tools.description: Writes new copy for a post with the AI pipeline, replacing the current copy. Costs 6 credits. Status is REGENERATING until it returns to READY_TO_APPROVE. Only for posts that belong to a calendar item. Returns an error for a carousel post.

id.description: The post ID to regenerate text for

tools.name: delete-post
tools.description: Deletes one post. The status of its calendar item is recalculated. Irreversible (reject-post keeps the post instead). Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

confirmToken.description: Token from the first call of this delete. Omitted: nothing is deleted and a summary plus token is returned.

tools.name: reject-post
tools.description: Marks a post REJECTED. It is never published and stays visible for reference. Only for posts not yet PUBLISHED. Costs no credits.

tools.name: edit-post-copy
tools.description: Replaces the stored copy (and optionally the title) of a post with the given text. No AI, no credits. Does not change the destination. A post that is already published keeps the copy that went live.

id.description: The post ID whose copy to replace

tools.name: regenerate-post-image
tools.description: Creates a new image for a post with the AI pipeline, replacing the current image. Costs 12 credits. Status is REGENERATING until it returns to READY_TO_APPROVE. Only for posts that belong to a calendar item. Returns an error for a carousel post; a carousel is made again as a whole with trigger-generation on its calendar item, or in the web app.

id.description: The post ID to regenerate the image for

tools.name: trigger-generation
tools.description: Generates posts for one calendar item, one per destination: research, copy, headline and image in the persona's voice. An item whose contentFormat is "carousel" gets a carousel of carouselSlides slides instead of the single image, which takes longer to make. Running it again deletes the item's existing posts and writes new ones. Returns post IDs immediately; generation takes 1 to 3 minutes. Finished posts are SCHEDULED (publish publicly at their time) on connections without approval, otherwise READY_TO_APPROVE. Costs 30 credits per post (15 with an uploaded image), deducted when each post finishes. Can read the page at a given URL.

contentEventId.description: The content event ID to generate posts for

inputType.description: Override the input type (defaults to the content event's inputType)

text.description: Override the text input for generation

url.description: Override the source URL for generation

imageUrl.description: Uploaded image URL (skips AI image generation, costs 15 credits instead of 30)

selectedConnections.description: Override which connection IDs to generate for (defaults to content event's selection)

tools.name: generate-for-content-events
tools.description: Starts generation for several calendar items at once and returns a per-item summary (post IDs and status, or an error). Items that are already generating restart. Same results and costs as trigger-generation for each item.

contentEventIds.description: Array of content event IDs to generate posts for

inputType.description: Override the input type for every event (defaults to each event's inputType)

text.description: Override the text input for every event

url.description: Override the source URL for every event

imageUrl.description: Uploaded image URL applied to every event (skips AI image gen, 15 credits/post)

selectedConnections.description: Override which connection IDs to generate for (applies to every event)

scenes.description: Scene IDs applied to every event

tools.name: get-generation-status
tools.description: Returns the status of posts, by post IDs or by calendar item. Posts move through GENERATION_IN_PROGRESS, EXTRACTING, GENERATING and COPY_GENERATED and end as SCHEDULED, READY_TO_APPROVE or GENERATION_FAILED. allComplete is true when every post has ended.

postIds.description: Specific post IDs to check (returned by trigger-generation)

initiatorId.description: Content event ID — returns all posts for this event

tools.name: get-me
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user: name, email, role and time zone. Campaign and post times follow this time zone.

tools.name: set-my-timezone
tools.description: Sets the signed-in user's IANA time zone. Campaigns planned afterwards use it; existing campaigns keep theirs.

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: Returns the team members of the account: id, name, email, role (OWNER, ADMIN or MEMBER) and status. Inviting, removing and role changes are not available through this server.

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Returns one team member: name, email, role, status and time zone.

tools.name: get-account
tools.description: Returns the account: credit balance, business name and location.

tools.name: get-prices
tools.description: Returns the available credit packages and their prices. Purchases are not available through this server.

tools.name: list-transactions
tools.description: Returns recent credit transactions of the account (purchases and spends).

tools.name: get-analytics
tools.description: Returns totals of reach, engagement and impressions for the account over a time window (1 to 365 days, default 30).

tools.name: get-analytics-filters
tools.description: Returns the available analytics filters: platforms, pages and date ranges.

tools.name: get-analytics-posts
tools.description: Returns engagement, impressions and reach per published post. Can be filtered by platform and page. Paginated with a cursor.

platform.description: Filter by platform: LINKEDIN, FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, X

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (opaque, from a previous response)

tools.name: refresh-analytics
tools.description: Fetches fresh analytics from the account's connected social accounts and returns the updated stats.

tools.name: list-campaigns
tools.description: Returns campaigns of the account, newest first. Can be filtered by status (DRAFT, PLAN_READY, LAUNCHED, FAILED). Paginated with limit and skip.

status.description: Filter by status: DRAFT, PLAN_READY, LAUNCHED, FAILED.

tools.name: get-campaign
tools.description: Returns one campaign. plan.pitch is the plan in plain words: targets (who it reaches), reach (per target: network, account, posts, time of day), talk (how it speaks to them), posters (who posts and their role) and frequency (posts per network). plan.blueprint.contentEvents is the calendar; each item has contentFormat ("image" or "carousel"), carouselSlides and formatWhy, the reason that format was chosen for that post. inputFilter.droppedCount counts statements removed from a text subject, with reasons.

tools.name: list-campaign-goals
tools.description: Returns the campaign goal strings accepted by plan-campaign.

tools.name: plan-campaign
tools.description: Starts planning a campaign for the given personas and goal: researches the audience and how to reach it on the public web, then writes the calendar and post copy. Nothing is generated or published. Returns campaignId immediately; planning takes a few minutes (get-campaign-planning shows progress). Without platforms or connectionIds, every connected account of each listed persona is used. Returns an error while planning already runs for this campaign.

subject.description: What the campaign is about: a persona ({ type: "persona", personaId }) or free text ({ type: "text", text }). Posts state only what the subject contains. A persona subject posts only if it is also in personas.

text.description: What the campaign is about, up to 2000 characters

clientPersonaId.description: Deprecated alias of subject { type: "persona", personaId }.

platform.description: Limits this persona to one network: X, LINKEDIN, FACEBOOK or INSTAGRAM.

platforms.description: Limits this persona to these networks. Omitted: every account of this persona.

connectionIds.description: Limits this persona to these connection IDs. Omitted: every account of this persona.

personas.description: Personas that may post: persona IDs as strings, or objects that limit networks or accounts.

durationDays.description: Days in the campaign, 1 to 31. Default 7. The app offers 7, 14, 21 and 30. Longer means more posts and credits.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default tomorrow. Today or later in the signed-in user's time zone (get-me).

tools.name: retry-plan
tools.description: Plans a FAILED campaign again with its original inputs. Returns 409 when the campaign already has a plan or is planning.

tools.name: adjust-campaign
tools.description: Requests a change to a PLAN_READY campaign from a plain-language message (who it reaches, how, the message, who posts, how often, dates, or single calendar items and their format); everything the change does not touch stays. Returns action: "ask" (a clarifying question), "decline" (the reason), "confirm" (a warning; send again with confirm true or false), or "adjusting" (what will change). While adjusting, campaignStatus is ADJUSTING until it is PLAN_READY again. Not available after launch. Returns 409 while another change runs.

message.description: The user's change, in their own words

confirm.description: Only to answer a "confirm" warning: true to go ahead, false to leave the plan as it is. Send without message.

tools.name: undo-campaign-adjust
tools.description: Reverts the most recent adjust-campaign change; each call goes one change further back. Not available after launch.

tools.name: launch-plan
tools.description: Generates and schedules every post of a PLAN_READY campaign; status becomes LAUNCHED. Costs 30 credits per post, one post per connection on each calendar item. Posts on connections without approval publish publicly at their time; others wait as READY_TO_APPROVE. Returns generated and generateFailed counts. Returns 409 before PLAN_READY, during a change, or when every date has passed.

tools.name: get-campaign-planning
tools.description: Returns planning progress of a campaign: campaignStatus (DRAFT while planning, ADJUSTING, PLAN_READY or FAILED), steps, and the plan once ready, in the same shape as get-campaign. Planning usually takes a few minutes.

tools.name: delete-campaign
tools.description: Deletes a campaign, the calendar items it created and their posts. Irreversible. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

confirmToken.description: Token from the first call of this delete. Omitted: nothing is deleted and a summary plus token is returned.

tools.name: search-scenes
tools.description: Searches the stock scene library by keywords. Returns matching scenes with IDs, thumbnails and metadata. Paginated.

tools.name: get-scene
tools.description: Returns one scene with its metadata and image URL.

tools.name: presign-upload
tools.description: Returns a time-limited upload URL and the final object key for one file (for a post image or persona asset). The file is uploaded with an HTTP PUT to that URL.

tools.name: signed-get
tools.description: Returns a time-limited URL to read one private file by its object key.

key.description: The S3 object key to sign
